title.value: Adversarial training approach for local data debiasing

title.quote: Adversarial training approach for local data debiasing

analysis.description: This paper introduces GANSan, a novel adversarial training approach leveraging Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to sanitize data by removing sensitive attributes and preventing discrimination. The sanitizer modifies attributes minimally to maintain data interpretability and prevent inference of sensitive information without knowledge of future tasks. Experiments on real datasets demonstrate the method's effectiveness and the trade-off between fairness and utility.
